lines.text: Every day at recess, Leo picks the same team. The one with nobody on it.
lines.say: (confident) Every day at recess, Leo picks the same team. The one with nobody on it.
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: He plays soccer alone against the whole class. And he loses. Every single day.
lines.say: (happy) He plays soccer alone against the whole class. And he loses. Every single day.
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: When Rex asked why, Leo pointed at the empty goal. That spot is taken.
lines.say: (serious) When Rex asked why, Leo pointed at the empty goal. That spot is taken.
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: Kids laughed. They called him Leo the Loser.
lines.say: (sad) Kids laughed. They called him Leo the Loser.
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: For a whole year, nobody stood in that goal. Leo never let anyone take it.
lines.say: (sad) For a whole year, nobody stood in that goal. Leo never let anyone take it.
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: Last year, Leo's best friend Ollie was the best goalie in school.
lines.say: (happy) Last year, Leo's best friend Ollie was the best goalie in school.
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: Then Ollie was hurt in a car accident. The doctors said he might never come back to school.
lines.say: (sad) Then Ollie was hurt in a car accident. The doctors said he might never come back to school.
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: Before Ollie moved away, Leo made him a promise. Your spot is waiting. I'll keep it until you come back.
lines.say: (soft tone) Before Ollie moved away, Leo made him a promise. Your spot is waiting. I'll keep it until you come back.
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: So every day, Leo played alone. Two hundred games. Two hundred losses.
lines.say: (serious) So every day, Leo played alone. Two hundred games. Two hundred losses.
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: Then one Monday, a boy in a wheelchair rolled onto the field.
lines.say: (happy) Then one Monday, a boy in a wheelchair rolled onto the field.
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: Leo dropped the ball and ran. Ollie! You're back!
lines.say: (happy) Leo dropped the ball and ran. Ollie! You're back!
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: Ollie looked at the empty goal. You really kept it for me?
lines.say: (sad) Ollie looked at the empty goal. You really kept it for me?
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: Rex looked at Ollie. Then at the scoreboard. Two hundred losses, all for one promise.
lines.say: (serious) Rex looked at Ollie. Then at the scoreboard. Two hundred losses, all for one promise.
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: Rex walked over and stood on Leo's side. So did everyone else.
lines.say: (confident) Rex walked over and stood on Leo's side. So did everyone else.
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: Ollie rolled into the goal. That day, Leo's team finally won. Ollie didn't let in a single goal.
lines.say: (happy) Ollie rolled into the goal. That day, Leo's team finally won. Ollie didn't let in a single goal.
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: Now nobody calls him Leo the Loser. They call him the kid who kept his promise.
lines.say: (happy) Now nobody calls him Leo the Loser. They call him the kid who kept his promise.
